doc.title: Gerald Wiggins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 2, 1995

title: Festival work and no more steady gigs
summary: He prefers short festival appearances to long club residencies.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: What’s in your future? Do you do these festivals quite often?

Yeah, I do them. I do Sarasota, New Jersey, you name it. This is easy. You do a couple of days, three days at the most, and come home. This time I’m home so it doesn’t matter. But it’s fun, and they pay the bills. It’s not like sitting on a steady job working from nine to one or nine to two every night. That I couldn’t do anymore. For no amount of money. It’s just—
I’m just not geared that way I can’t even stay in a club a week. I get antsy after one or two days and I want out.
